milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the cut_red_sandstone_slab (centered at spawn-relative [1, 0, 3]) and face toward it. max_distance=5 ensures the player actually walks to the first target area rather than spotting it from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the smooth_stone_slab (centered at spawn-relative [1, 0, 9]) and face toward it. max_distance=5 ensures the player walks past the first target to reach the second one, preserving the sequential dependency. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the pink_carpet (centered at spawn-relative [1, 0, 15]) and face toward it. max_distance=5 ensures the player walks to the end of the corridor to reach the final target. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.
